description: Fetch raw app reviews (unified schema across stores: rating/title/body/version/date/devReply/thumbsUp), 50 per page. Use for drill-down after mine_app_pain_points.

appId.description: App Store or Google Play URL, iOS numeric id (e.g. 324684580) or Android package (e.g. com.spotify.music) — get ids from search_apps

sort.description: default recent (Android only; iOS uses the store default order)

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (numeric id / App Store URL → ios, package / Play URL → android)

name: get_app_reviews
title: Raw reviews
